name: cie-1924-photopic-V
citation: CIE 1924 photopic luminous efficiency function V(λ), equal to the ȳ(λ) of the CIE 1931 2° standard observer; values from the CVRL table (cvrl.org) as packaged in luxpy 1.12.5 (luxpy/data/cmfs/ciexyz_1931_2.dat).
source: CVRL CIE 1931 2° colour matching functions, column ȳ, read 2026-10-28
use: Weights of the five-wavelength polychromatic PSF (spec §5.4), for an equal-energy spectrum; normalized to sum 1 in eye-model's PHOTOPIC.
